extensionName.message: Wpp Discreto — Aliases and message protection

extensionDescription.message: Local group aliases and adjustable message blurring for WhatsApp Web.

historyHint.message: The lower area stays readable. Scroll to read older messages there (20% to 100%). Full blur covers the entire conversation.

aliasPlaceholder.message: Name to show in this browser

aliasMatchingHint.message: Chats with identical names share an alias. Search uses the original name.

statusSaveFailed.message: Could not save. Please try again.

statusMissingAlias.message: Enter the original name and alias.

statusLoadFailed.message: Could not load settings. Reopen the extension.

chatLookupHint.message: Show up to 10 conversations loaded in the current tab.

chatsUnavailable.message: Open or reload WhatsApp Web in this tab to check names.

aliasNotFound.message: Not found in the loaded conversations. Check the name or open the chat and try again.

localOnlyNotice.message: Aliases and settings are only visible to you, in this browser. Your messages and original names stay unchanged on WhatsApp.

conversationDataNotice.message: Wpp Discreto does not send or save the contents of your conversations.

resetConfirmDescription.message: Settings will return to their defaults. Your saved aliases will be kept.

mediaOptionsHint.message: In conversations, the protected area also blurs media. Selected types always stay fully blurred, including when opened.

mediaFallbackHint.message: If any type is selected, unidentified media will also be blurred.

advancedBlurHelp.message: Selects photos, videos and stickers to always stay blurred. Adjust each type in settings (gear). Audio stays visible.
